skills.label: Create custom subagents
skills.desc: Create and use specialized AI subagents in Claude Code for task-specific workflows and improved context management.

skills.label: Manage multiple agents with agent view
skills.desc: Dispatch and manage many Claude Code sessions from one screen. Agent view shows what every session is doing and which ones need your input.

skills.label: Message your other Claude Code sessions
skills.desc: Let Claude list and message your other Claude Code sessions on this machine, and reach your sessions on other machines or in the cloud.

skills.label: Orchestrate subagents at scale with dynamic workflows
skills.desc: Dynamic workflows orchestrate many subagents from a script Claude writes and you can rerun. Use them for codebase audits, large migrations, and cross-checked research.

skills.label: Orchestrate teams of Claude Code sessions
skills.desc: Coordinate multiple Claude Code instances working together as a team, with shared tasks, inter-agent messaging, and centralized management.

skills.label: Run agents in parallel
skills.desc: Compare the ways Claude Code can take on multiple tasks at once: subagents, agent view, agent teams, dynamic workflows, and projects.

skills.label: Run parallel sessions with worktrees
skills.desc: Isolate parallel Claude Code sessions in separate git worktrees so changes don't collide. Covers the --worktree flag, subagent isolation, .worktreeinclude, cleanup, and non-git VCS hooks.

skills.label: Share session output as artifacts
skills.desc: Artifacts turn Claude Code's work into live, interactive pages on claude.ai that you can keep private, share with your organization, or publish to a public link.

skills.label: Automate actions with hooks
skills.desc: Run shell commands automatically when Claude Code edits files, finishes tasks, or needs input. Format code, send notifications, validate commands, and enforce project rules.

skills.label: Keep Claude working toward a goal
skills.desc: Set a completion condition with /goal and Claude keeps working until it's met, a model judges it impossible, or an error you have to fix clears the goal.

skills.label: Launch sessions from links
skills.desc: Open a Claude Code terminal session from a URL. Embed claude-cli:// links in runbooks, alerts, and dashboards so a click opens Claude Code in the right repo with the right prompt.

skills.label: Push events into a running session with channels
skills.desc: Use channels to push messages, alerts, and webhooks into your Claude Code session from an MCP server. Forward CI results, chat messages, and monitoring events so Claude can react while you're away.

skills.label: Run Claude Code programmatically
skills.desc: Use the Agent SDK to run Claude Code programmatically from the CLI, Python, or TypeScript.

skills.label: Run prompts on a schedule
skills.desc: Use /loop and the cron scheduling tools to run prompts repeatedly, poll for status, or set one-time reminders within a Claude Code session.

skills.label: Set up Claude Code in a monorepo or large codebase
skills.desc: Configure Claude Code for monorepos and large single-tree codebases with nested CLAUDE.md files, sparse worktrees, code intelligence, and per-package skills so Claude stays focused on the code you're working in.

skills.label: Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP
skills.desc: Learn how to connect Claude Code to your tools with the Model Context Protocol.

skills.label: Connect to MCP servers
skills.desc: Add an MCP server to Claude Code, verify the connection, and find the configuration on disk.

skills.label: Extend Claude with skills
skills.desc: Create, manage, and share skills to extend Claude's capabilities in Claude Code. Includes custom commands and bundled skills.

skills.label: Debug your configuration
skills.desc: Diagnose why CLAUDE.md, settings, hooks, MCP servers, or skills aren't taking effect. Use /context, /doctor, /hooks, and /mcp to see what actually loaded.

skills.label: Error reference
skills.desc: Look up Claude Code runtime error messages with what each one means and how to fix it.

skills.label: Troubleshoot installation and login
skills.desc: Fix command not found, PATH, permission, network, and authentication errors when installing or signing in to Claude Code.

skills.label: Troubleshooting
skills.desc: Fix high CPU or memory usage, hangs, auto-compact thrashing, and search problems in Claude Code, and find the right page for other issues.
